text:
Ava M.: Ok team — quick kickoff for the Embedded Solution Showcase sprint. Goal: publish a launch blog + run a 30-min live demo with partner listing in Aurora Cloud Catalog, and map inbound leads into SDR queue. Target publish = next Wed (5 business days). Who's in for tasks?

Priya S.: I'm in. I'll own the blog outline, partner quotes, and the social blurb. Draft ETA: Tue noon for review. Need an updated integration screenshot from product.

Leo R.: I'll get the demo environment ready. ETA: tomorrow EOD. Need to know which feature surface we want to highlight (prefix-caching + cold-start perf).

Jordan K.: I'll coordinate the webinar slot and promo cadence. Proposed live date = Thu (two days after publish) 10am PT. Also need the inbound routing logic for trial signups from the catalog listing — want to attach high intent tag.

Nadia L.: SDRs need a short qualification script and a lead folder in HubSpot. If we mark inbound leads with `source=aurora_catalog` and `campaign=embedded-showcase` we can route with existing queues. Happy to draft script.

Priya S.: Blog outline (high level): 1) problem (latency/cost for embed-heavy apps), 2) solution (Redwood + Aurora listing: dev-first deploy), 3) benchmark highlights, 4) partner quote + CTA to catalog + demo signup. Will include 2 callouts: quickstart link and pricing note.

Ava M.: Love it. Two asks: (1) Jordan — can you confirm calendar + partner availability by EOD? (2) Leo — send the screenshot + a 60s gif for the blog. Also add an internal tag `mk-prod:embedded-showcase`.

Leo R.: Pushing a build to staging now. IntegrationsBot: deploy status?

IntegrationsBot: Deployment 8971 -> staging completed for `embedded-showcase` (image + gif assets). Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/previews/embedded-showcase  :white_check_mark:

Jordan K.: Partner confirmed for Thu 10am PT. I'll create the webinar page and embed the signup form. Draft promo timeline: Day -3 email to partners list, Day -2 social snippets, Day -1 reminder + blog publish day cross-post.

Nadia L.: Draft SDR script snippet below — feel free to tweak: 
```
Hi {{first_name}}, saw you signed up via Aurora Cloud Catalog — wanted to introduce myself. Quick Q: are you evaluating for production inference or exploration? If production, ask about peak tokens/sec and compliance needs. Offer 15-min tech sync + private trial.
```

Jordan K.: For routing, propose simple mapping in HubSpot: 
```
if lead.source == "aurora_catalog":
  lead.owner = "sdr_inbound_catalog"
  lead.tags += ["catalog","embedded-showcase","high-intent"]
```
Will set up automation Monday.

Priya S.: I put a placeholder for partner quote. @Leo — can you confirm the bench numbers we want to show? Keep them conservative: cold-start latency ~120ms, token cost delta ~30% vs baseline.

Leo R.: Confirmed. Bench run finished. I'll drop the CSV and a short note in the product channel. Also prepping a 2-step rollback demo in case live goes weird.

Ava M.: Action items: 
- Priya: blog draft + social copy (Tue noon)
- Leo: assets + bench CSV (tomorrow EOD)
- Jordan: webinar page + promo timeline (EOD)
- Nadia: SDR folder + script (Mon morning)
I'll compile PR checklist and run through with partner. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept tasks.

Priya S.: :thumbsup:

Leo R.: :thumbsup: Added demo GIF link to staging preview.

Jordan K.: :thumbsup: I'll ping when webinar page is live.

Nadia L.: :thumbsup: Will prep SDR playbook and sync with ops on routing Monday.

Ava M.: Thanks all — last note: use `embedded-showcase` in all campaign UTM params to keep tracking clean. I'll loop in partner PM on the blog draft once Priya posts.

IntegrationsBot: Reminder scheduled — run the catalog metadata validation job tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Priya S.: Posting draft now for internal review: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/embedded-showcase-blog — feedback welcome.

Ava M.: Reviewing now, will drop comments inline.

Jordan K.: Webinar page live: https://events.redwood.ai/embedded-showcase  — signup hooked to HubSpot form `hs_form_334`.

Nadia L.: HubSpot automation created and test lead flow verified. Test lead arrived with `source=aurora_catalog` and tag `embedded-showcase`. Good to go.

Ava M.: Great execution! We'll do a quick postmortem + metric dashboard 1 week after publish. Thanks everyone. :tada:
